title: MuGE: Multiple Granularity Edge Detection
mechanism: A small network estimates a granularity scalar from each annotation. The scalar is injected into the multi-scale and high-frequency features, so one model can output edges at any requested granularity or annotator style.
adaptation: Condition on label style, not granularity: a per-cell scalar for measured crack label width and mean offset to the dark ridge, or a source one-hot. Implement as FiLM in the U-Net++ decoder. At test time give the known source, or the value that is best on val. This targets the BRIEF point that strict IoU near 0.5 is a ceiling unless the model learns each source's convention.
min_experiment: Arm: house + FiLM style conditioning, 5 seeds. Baseline: house at 100% labels. Metrics: per-source crack IoU (BMRK 0.379, CFVS without train twin 0.397), overall crack IoU, E1 relF1@2 using the CSIR style. Kill if no source gains >= 0.02 and overall crack IoU is n.d.
evidence: R: one model produces multiple controllable edge maps and is competitive on BSDS500 and Multicue. Per-number detail not read (snippets were rate-limited).
prior_overlap: BRIEF 5 lists source-conditional prediction as never tried. Open.

alt_notes.adaptation: Condition on label style instead: per-cell scalar of measured crack label width and mean offset to the dark ridge, or a source one-hot, via FiLM in the U-Net++ decoder; at test feed the known source or the val-optimal value, so the model reproduces each source's convention.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house + FiLM source/label-width conditioning, 5 seeds; baseline house 5 seeds. Key metric per-source crack IoU (BMRK 0.379, CFVS-no-twin 0.397) and overall crack IoU. Kill if no source gains >= 0.02 and overall n.d. About 8 GPU-h.

alt_notes.adaptation: Replace discrete source ID with a continuous per-cell label width w (crack area / skeleton length of that cell's label, about 1 to 3.5 px) fed through FiLM to the decoder; captures within-source annotator variation. At test set w to the source median width, or tune w per source on CV folds.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house PF + width-FiLM, 5 seeds, w = source median at test; second readout with CV-tuned w. Baseline: house PF 5 seeds. Metric: clean-49 crack IoU and relF1@2. Kill if crack IoU gain < +0.012.
